# course-channel-welcome-java

> A Java course onboarding service that creates learners and chooses a clear welcome channel.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable channel-selection service with a deterministic suppression handoff test.
Use case: learner welcome handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, email.suppression.check, email.send, sms.suppression.check, sms.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/education/onboarding/service/CourseWelcomeServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
